title: Fallback unit responsibility
responsibility: Creates an explicitly derived placeholder from a unit’s kind and title when no human responsibility has been declared.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.kind
inputs.description: The unit kind, which picks the purpose phrase from the module's purpose table by an exact, case-sensitive key and is the only input that changes that phrase. A kind with no entry produces the kind followed by unit, but inherited Object.prototype names such as constructor or toString are found by the lookup and never reach that fallback.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.title
inputs.description: The unit title, inserted unchanged after 'Owns the' in every result; it is not trimmed or validated, so an empty title leaves two adjacent spaces.

outputs.name: derivedResponsibility
outputs.description: A placeholder sentence for a unit nobody has described yet, in the form Owns the title purpose followed by a period, where the purpose is the value the kind looks up in the purpose table, or the kind followed by unit when that lookup finds nothing. It restates only the kind and title and contains no marker that it is derived, so it must not be read as a reviewed description of behavior.
